policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: lawsuit seeks freeze on frontier AI development
items.summary: AP reports advocacy groups filed a motion seeking a halt on new frontier AI model development, naming O among defendants.

items.headline: O: 100,000 researchers gain GPT access
items.summary: O announced free access for 100,000 academic researchers to its most advanced models via ChatGPT to accelerate scientific research and discovery.

items.headline: G: Muse Spark open-weight limited preview
items.summary: G announced that Meta’s Muse Spark open-weight model is available in limited preview on GroqCloud on launch day.
